subject.title: [Bug]: Lane remains occupied after reply emitted during failover — blocks subsequent inbound messages

question: Should OpenClaw admit same-session follow-up turns immediately after durable visible delivery while failover/backend cleanup continues, and what transcript and ordering invariants must gate that handoff?
rationale: The code can be changed mechanically, but the safe release point crosses user-visible delivery, transcript durability, failover cleanup, and session ordering semantics that need maintainer intent.

options.title: Delivery-Gated Handoff
options.body: Release or adopt session admission after durable visible delivery and explicit transcript/order guards, then validate with source tests and live Telegram failover proof.

options.title: Keep Lane-Held Semantics
options.body: Keep the lane occupied until backend completion and instead add clearer busy/failover feedback for queued follow-ups.

options.title: Defer To Broader Scheduler Work
options.body: Leave this issue open under the broader lane-fairness/session-scheduler cluster until maintainers choose one unified admission model.

recommendation.title: Delivery-Gated Handoff
recommendation.body: Release or adopt session admission after durable visible delivery and explicit transcript/order guards, then validate with source tests and live Telegram failover proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent embedded runner and reply/follow-up drain work makes this owner the best available decision route for cross-surface delivery semantics.
